expectations.text: The report fits one page plus an optional appendix
expectations.evidence: The report body runs from '# DevRel - Q3 - for the CTO' to 'Decision asked'. It holds a two-sentence headline, a 4-row results table with 3 short bullets, a 1-row leading-indicator table, a 1-row miss table, a short cost paragraph, 3 next-period items and a decision. That is about 450-500 words, so it plausibly fits one page. The appendix is set apart under '**Appendix**'. The assumptions and pass-threshold notes sit outside the report, and the response itself says padding would weaken it ('A thin page... make a complete page'). It has a summary, a decision line, a metric table and four detailed metric sections, one of which contains its own sub-table. 'Blind spots' and 'Next quarter' sections follow after that. The likely appendix material ('Two additions I left out of the main page', 'Optional additions') is not labeled as an appendix.
